description: Fetch official MLB data from statsapi.mlb.com — teams, rosters, schedules, standings, stat lines, box scores, leaders, and reference data.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used by schedule, box score, and player stats (statType=byDateRange).
endDate.title: End date

gamePks.description: MLB game IDs (gamePk), e.g. 822974. Used by mode=getBoxscore. Leave empty to derive games from seasons, dates, or teams.
gamePks.title: Game IDs

gameType.description: Filter games and stats by game type. Regular season is R; other codes include spring training (S), wild card (F), division series (D), league championship (L), World Series (W), and All-Star (A).
gameType.title: Game type

includeStats.description: For mode=getPlayers, attach each player's season stats for the selected stat group.
includeStats.title: Include season stats

includeTeamTotals.description: For mode=getBoxscore, add one team-total record per side per game, including the inning-by-inning line score.
includeTeamTotals.title: Include team totals and line score

leaderCategory.description: Stat category for mode=getLeaders. Choose a category that belongs to the selected stat group, e.g. homeRuns, battingAverage, or runsBattedIn for hitting; earnedRunAverage, strikeouts, or saves for pitching; fieldingPercentage or errors for fielding.
leaderCategory.title: Leader category

leagueId.description: Filter standings and leaders to the American League, National League, or both.
leagueId.title: League

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of records returned (1–10,000).
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: What to fetch. Nine modes cover teams, players/rosters, player stats, game logs, schedules, standings, box scores, leaders, and reference data.
mode.title: Mode

playerIds.description: MLB player IDs, e.g. 660271 for Shohei Ohtani. Used by players, player stats, and game log modes. Use Search query to find a player ID by name.
playerIds.title: Player IDs

referenceType.description: Which reference dataset to return for mode=getReference.
referenceType.title: Reference data

rosterType.description: Which roster to return for mode=getPlayers when teamIds is set.
rosterType.title: Roster type

searchQuery.description: Find players by name for mode=getPlayers, e.g. Ohtani or Aaron Judge. Returns up to 50 matching players.
searchQuery.title: Search query

seasons.description: Season years, e.g. 2024 or 2025. Leave empty for the current season. Stats cover 1876 onward; schedules cover 1901 onward. Multiple seasons can be fetched in one run (mode=getTeams, getPlayers, getPlayerStats, getSchedule, getStandings, getLeaders, getReference).
seasons.title: Seasons

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used by schedule, box score, and player stats (statType=byDateRange). A single date can be set in either date field.
startDate.title: Start date

statGroup.description: Which stat category to return for players, player stats, game logs, box scores, and leaders.
statGroup.title: Stat group

statType.description: Scope for mode=getPlayerStats. Season, career, and date-range stats work for the whole player pool; season-by-season, month, day-of-week, and home/away splits require playerIds or teamIds.
statType.title: Stat type

teamIds.description: Filter by MLB team IDs (147 = Yankees), team names (Yankees), abbreviations (NYY), or team URLs (https://www.mlb.com/yankees). Leave empty for all teams. Used by teams, players, player stats, schedule, standings, box score, and leaders modes.
teamIds.title: Teams

title: Official MLB Team, Schedule & Stat Line Scraper Input
